Docs.Text: Toggles between open, stop, close.\n For single button control.
Co - Complete open [Digital] \n If in motion, stops.
Cc - Complete close [Digital]\n If in motion, stops.
Io - Is open [Digital]\n Input is used to report the 'fully opened' position via a limit switch or similar.
Ic - Is Closed [Digital]\n Input is used to report the 'fully closed' position via a limit switch or similar.
Off- Off/Lock[Digital]\n Pulse (< 200 ms): Stops movement. Pulse (> 200 ms): Block is locked\n
Po - Partially Open [Digital]\n Moves Gate to partially open position if current position is different.
Spo - Sensor prevent opening[Digital]\n If active, opening is prevented but closing is still possible. Used to connect a photoelectric sensor or similar.
Spc - Sensor prevent closing[Digital]\n If active, closing is prevented but opening is still possible. Used to connect a photoelectric sensor or similar.
DisPc - Disable periphery control [Digital]\n Disables inputs Tg, Co, Cc, T5 when On (eg. Child lock, cleaning)\n Control via user interface is still possible.
Tg - Pulse to Open/Stop/Close [Digital]
Op - Open[Digital]
Cl - Close[Digital]
Im - In motion[Digital]
Pos - Position\n 0 = Closed, 100 = Open\n Value Range: 0...1
Wl - Warning light[Digital]\n For activating a flashing warning light when the gate is moving.\n On/Off is defined via parameters (Wlon) and (Wloff).

Rem - Remanence input[Digital]
 Remanence input: If active, the function block retains its previous state after a program reboot
 The state of the function block is saved:
 -When saving to the Device
 -At a planned reboot
 -Before a backup
 -Once per hour
 The data is saved on internal memory

Type - Type
 Animation Type
 0 = Garage Door
 1 = Single Gate opening to the left
 2 = Single Gate opening to the right
 3 = Gate opening to both sides
 4 = Folding Door opening to the left
 5 = Folding Door opening to the right
 Value Range 0...5, Default Value: 0

Variant.Text: 1 = Single door opening to the left
2 = Single gate opening to the right
4 = Sliding door opening to the left
5 = Sliding door opening to the right

Docs.Text: Opd - Opening Duration[s]\n Value Range: 0...inf, Default Value: 60
Cld - Closing Duration[s]\n Value Range: 0...inf, Default Value: 60
PoPos - Partially Open Position\n Target Position for Input Po.

Pd - Pulse duration [s]
 Pulse duration of outputs Tg, Op, Cl.
 This parameter is only visible in certain configurations.
 Value Range: 0...inf, Default Value: 0.5

Pdp - Pulse pause duration[s]
 Pause duration between two subsequent pulses of outputs Tg, Op, Cl.
 This parameter is only visible in certain configurations.
 Value Range: 0...inf, Default Value: 0.5
Mld - Motor lock duration[s]\n Duration of motor lock between direction changes.\n Value RangeL 0...inf. Default Value: 0.5
Wlon - Warning light on duration[s]\n Value Range: 0...inf, Default Value: 1
Wloff - Warning light off duration[s]\n Value Range: 0...inf, Default Value: 1
